# gramlot-examples 0.3.26

Updates the gallery to the reviewed common base, including Grid editing, upload queues, attachment management, local image editing and Visual Source composition. The behavioral catalogue now covers these lessons, and the local qualification servers serve the shared lazy Markdown module.

Asqueel selector examples demonstrate reactive caption selection while retaining the selected key. Database-specific capabilities remain separate from generic examples; database datasets do not include the Invoice application.

Public deployments keep Remote Edit disabled. Native mobile examples remain an external catalogue, visible inside Capacitor; this release does not upload a TestFlight build.

The unpublished 0.3.25 candidate was stopped by an inspector test-build import mapping. The mapping is corrected; no released tag is rewritten.
